name: Action object shape
description: A Redux action is a plain JavaScript object that describes 'what happened'. It must have a `type` field, typically a string, and may carry additional data needed to update state.
notes: Actions are the only way to send data into the store — they must be dispatched, never applied directly.

name: Action creator
description: A function that constructs and returns an action object, avoiding the need to hand-write the object literal at every dispatch call site.
returns: A plain action object ready to be passed to dispatch().
example:
const addTodo = (text) => ({ type: 'todos/added', payload: text });
store.dispatch(addTodo('Buy milk'));
notes: With Redux Toolkit's createSlice, action creators are generated automatically for each reducer you define.

name: Action types
description: String constants used as the `type` field of actions, conventionally namespaced as 'feature/event' (e.g. 'todos/added') to avoid collisions between reducers.
example:
export const TODO_ADDED = 'todos/added';
// used as: { type: TODO_ADDED, payload: 'Buy milk' }
notes: Defining types as constants avoids typos between where an action is dispatched and where it's handled in a reducer.

name: Flux Standard Action (FSA)
syntax: { type: string, payload?: any, error?: boolean, meta?: any }
description: A convention for shaping action objects consistently: a required `type`, an optional `payload` for the data, an optional `error` boolean, and an optional `meta` for extra context that isn't part of the payload.
example: { type: 'todos/addFailed', payload: new Error('Network error'), error: true }
notes: Redux Toolkit's createAction/createSlice generate FSA-compliant actions by default.

name: Dispatching actions
description: The process of sending an action to the store via store.dispatch (or the useDispatch hook in React) so the reducer can compute new state.
notes: With thunk middleware installed, dispatch can also accept a function (a thunk) instead of a plain action object, enabling async logic.

name: createAction()
description: A Redux Toolkit utility that generates an FSA-compliant action creator for a given action type string, optionally using a 'prepare' callback to customize the payload.
parameters: type — the action type string. prepareCallback — optional function that returns the { payload, meta } shape.
returns: An action creator function with a `.type` property and a `.match()` type-guard method.
notes: createSlice generates these for you automatically, so createAction is mostly used standalone outside of slices.
